pinterest.title: Santorini Wedding Packages: What They Include and What They Leave Out
pinterest.description: Santorini wedding packages share a name and very little else. Most cover a ceremony space, its set-up, a coordinator and set hours in that space. Food and drink, guest rooms, sole use of the venue, late finishes and outside suppliers are where they part ways. Our guide sets out what Santorini venue packages include, what sits outside them and how to put two quotes side by side.

pinterest.title: Are Santorini Wedding Packages All Inclusive? What to Ask Every Venue
pinterest.description: Rarely, in the sense most couples mean. A Santorini wedding package includes what its list names and nothing more. At some venues food and drink sit outside the package, rooms can be a condition rather than an inclusion, and some venues require a wedding planner on top. Read any package as the core of the day, and ask for every item outside it in writing.

pinterest.title: How to Compare Santorini Wedding Package Quotes Like for Like
pinterest.description: Two Santorini wedding quotes rarely line up on first reading. Put both on the same footing: inclusions in writing, ceremony type, guest count, exclusive use, rooms and nights, music times, food and drink, a weather plan, step-free access, supplier rules, currency and deposit terms. Once both quotes answer the same questions, the real difference is usually obvious.

slides: Santorini wedding packages share a name and very little else. Here is what they include, and what they leave out.
The core: a ceremony space for set hours, a basic set-up of tables, chairs and linen, someone to coordinate the day, and a toast.
Three shapes you will meet: a named package with fixed inclusions, a venue fee for spaces and staff, or space hire by the session.
Where packages part ways: food and drink, guest rooms, sole use of the venue, late finishes and outside suppliers.
Rooms can be a condition, not an inclusion. At some venues the room requirement grows with your guest list.
Some venues require a wedding planner on top of the venue fee. Others, like Canaves and Kapari, keep the planning in house.
Compare quotes on the same guest count, spaces, hours, nights, music times and currency, and ask every question in writing.
Holding two quotes that don't line up? Send them to us and a Wedded Advisor will talk them through with you. Link in bio.
instagram_carousel.caption:
Santorini wedding packages share a name and very little else.

Most bundle a ceremony space, its set-up, a coordinator and a set number of hours in that space. Guest rooms, sole use of the venue, food and drink, late finishes and outside suppliers are where they part ways, and each venue draws that line in its own place.

Our new guide sets out what Santorini venue packages include, what sits outside them and how to put two quotes side by side, with examples from Canaves, Santorini Gem, Grace Hotel, Andronis and Vedema.

A few things to ask every venue:
Is the space yours alone, and for how long?
Do you have to book rooms to secure the package, and for how many nights?
When does the music stop?
Which outside suppliers are allowed?
Is a wedding planner required on top of the venue fee?

Planning a small wedding or an elopement? Several venues size their packages for a couple alone or a small guest list, so the guide covers those too.

Holding quotes that don't line up? Send us a message and a Wedded Advisor will talk them through with you, inclusion by inclusion. Full guide at the link in our bio.
